question: Client assets per advisor across the five -- and is that comparison even valid?

cells.label: fact

items.text: The Bank of America investor day deck reports Merrill | Private Bank has over 15K wealth advisors.

The Bank of America supplement reports total wealth advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking at period end: 18,916 for 2023 Q1, 19,273 for 2023 Q2, 19,130 for 2023 Q3, and 19,099 for 2023 Q4.
items.quote:
Total wealth advisors (3) 18,916 19,273 18,916 19,130 19,099 19,243 19,273
(3) Includes advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking.
